note: Transcribed from the published SI; only PDF line wrapping and whitespace were normalized. Labels are source labels, not automatically renumbered. S25 specifies Gaussian 16 Revision B.01. S27(b) concerns Coulomb-fitting basis sets. S29 concerns dispersion damping; verify the actual dispersion option before citing. Availability does not imply that every reference applies to current calculations.
